decision.explanation: Gabriela Soto is described as representing both Penzance A.F.C. (a local association football club in D1S6) and the Mexican cycling team Swapit-Agolico (as stated in D2S17). These are distinct referents—football and cycling—and thus both are valid answers. The phrase 'Mexican cycling team' (C2) is not a specific team name and is therefore less precise than 'Swapit-Agolico', which is explicitly named in the source. As such, C2 is not retained in favor of the more specific C1.
